notes.title: Announcing Nintendo Switch port
notes.notes:
We are pleased to annouce that,
Wataju: My Super Fulfilling Real Life!, is coming to Nintendo Switch™ platform.

In the port, we are adding Traditional Chinese language support,
but English language support is still absent, however.

More details are available in below language, as press release.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2106520/view/4197991259842678619?utm_campaign=nx+announcement+redir+ja&l=japanese]Japanese / 日本語[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2106520/view/4197991259842678619?utm_campaign=nx+announcement+redir+zht&l=tchinese]Traditional Chinese / 繁體中文[/url]

notes.title: Opt-in macOS public test build
notes.notes:
Starting from today, we are providing [b]limited availability[/b] to macOS.
That means, we are providing macOS build as-is, without warranty or guarantee of any kind.

At the moment you have to opt-in "macos" beta branch to enable it.
Note that the App Bundle is non-notarized. You have to use it at your own risk.

This test build does not include Japanese build, therefore it will be Simplified Chinese only.
When proper i18n support drops in, more information may be shared by then.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2106520/view/3705938754323516372?l=schinese]View this announcement in Chinese[/url]
（中文公告请看此处）
